[[File:Bop-a-Zot_-_Star_Tours_Paris.jpg|250px|thumb|Bop a Zot games at Astroport Interstellar Services]]
'''''Bop a Zot''''' was an electronic game available to visitors of [[Astroport Interstellar Services]], a section of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Paris only}}</ref> In the game, players capture "zot" creatures that are infecting luggage viewed through a baggage scanner.<ref name="Tilt">{{BookCite|author=Feroyd, Morgan|container=IBM atterrit chez Mickey|title=Tilt|number=no. 117|date=September 1993|language=French|link=https://archive.org/details/Tilt117/mode/2up}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Bop a Zot'' was also a real game at the Astroport Interstellar Services arcade area, located after the exit of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride at [[Disneyland Paris]] from [[1993]] to [[2005]].<ref name="SW Universe">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwars-universe.com/dossier-page-115-736-star-tours-l-attraction-phenomene-les-decors.html|text=Star Tours L'Attraction Phenomene|work=StarWars-Universe.com|archivedate=20201128131949}}</ref>
